description: This Java class defines a response object for the 'CloseConnection' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the response details, including connection ID and HTTP status, and provides methods for creating instances from JSON and for serialization.

classes.name: CloseConnectionResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a CloseConnection command, encapsulating connection ID, HTTP status, headers, and providing JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.description: Creates a CloseConnectionResponse instance from a JSON string.
